title: 1099 Schedule C Tax Organizer — Self Employed Tax Organizer for Freelancers & Independent Contractors: Income Log with Missing-1099 Count, Expense
description: This 1099 Schedule C tax organizer is a self employed tax organizer built for one job: turning a freelancer's shoebox year into one folder a preparer can work from. If you file Schedule C, your records currently live in a shoebox, three payment apps, an email inbox and your memory — and every spring your CPA, EA or tax preparer gets all four, unsorted. This freelancer tax organizer spreadsheet runs the whole chain in one workbook instead: every payment in, every expense filed under the form's own labels, every business mile logged, every quarterly payment recorded, and one hand-off page that totals itself. The Income Log takes one line per payment — date, payer, amount — with 1099-expected and 1099-received dropdowns on every row. At year-end it counts your ⚠ MISSING 1099s by formula : the payers who owe you a form, named while it is still January and chasing them is easy. (Income is recorded whether or not a form arrives — the count keeps the folder honest, not the income.) The Expense Log files every cost under a Schedule C category dropdown that uses the form's own printed labels — Advertising, Contract labor, Office expense, Supplies, all 23 of them — with a receipt-on-file flag and formula totals by category . And when you do not know where something goes, you do not guess: you set the ⚠ Ask CPA flag , and the organiser turns "I don't know" into a written question list for your preparer. That flag is the heart of this kit. The Mileage Log records each business trip — date, from/to, purpose, miles — and totals your business miles and business % by formula .
